import json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

models = data['model_benchmarks']['data']
dimensions = data['model_benchmarks']['dimensions']

# Family color mapping (colorblind-friendly palette)
family_colors = {
    'GPT':     '#3182bd',  # blue
    'Claude':  '#9e4b91',  # purple
    'Gemini':  '#31a354',  # green
    'LLaMA':   '#e6550d',  # orange
    'Qwen':    '#d62728',  # red
}

# Line style by model name (solid for flagship, dashed for lightweight)
def get_linestyle(model):
    lightweight = ['mini', 'Flash', '7B', '70B']
    return '--' if any(l in model for l in lightweight) else '-'

# Width based on overall performance (thicker = better)
def get_linewidth(model):
    scores = [model[d] for d in dimensions if d in model]
    avg = sum(scores) / len(scores)
    return 1.0 + (avg - 50) / 50 * 1.5  # maps 50-100 → 1.0-2.5

# Create figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(16, 10))

# Normalize dimensions to [0, 1] for y-axis
dim_min = {d: 0 for d in dimensions}
dim_max = {d: 100 for d in dimensions}

# X positions for axes
n_dims = len(dimensions)
x_positions = np.linspace(0.08, 0.92, n_dims)

# Draw axis lines
for i, dim in enumerate(dimensions):
    ax.plot([x_positions[i], x_positions[i]], [0.05, 0.95],
            color='#555555', linewidth=1.5, zorder=2)
    ax.text(x_positions[i], 0.97, dim,
            ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold',
            color='#333333')
    ax.text(x_positions[i], 0.03, '0',
            ha='center', va='top', fontsize=8, color='#888888')
    ax.text(x_positions[i], 0.93, '100',
            ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8, color='#888888')

# Normalize value to [0.05, 0.95] y-space
def norm(val):
    return 0.05 + (val / 100) * 0.90

# Draw polylines per model
for model in models:
    family = model['family']
    color = family_colors[family]
    lw = get_linewidth(model)
    ls = get_linestyle(model)

    y_vals = [norm(model[dim]) for dim in dimensions]
    ax.plot(x_positions, y_vals,
            color=color, linewidth=lw, linestyle=ls,
            alpha=0.85, zorder=3)

# Title
ax.set_title('AI Model Capability Benchmark — Parallel Coordinates',
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', color='#222222', pad=18)
ax.text(0.5, 1.02, '10 models across 8 dimensions | scores normalized 0–100',
        transform=ax.transAxes, ha='center', fontsize=10, color='#666666', style='italic')

# Remove axes
ax.axis('off')

# Legend for families
legend_patches = [mpatches.Patch(color=c, label=f) for f, c in family_colors.items()]
legend1 = ax.legend(handles=legend_patches, title='Model Family',
                   loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(0.01, 0.99),
                   frameon=True, framealpha=0.9, fontsize=10, title_fontsize=11)
ax.add_artist(legend1)

# Line style legend
solid = plt.Line2D([0], [0], color='gray', linewidth=1.5, linestyle='-', label='Flagship')
dashed = plt.Line2D([0], [0], color='gray', linewidth=1.5, linestyle='--', label='Lightweight')
legend2 = ax.legend(handles=[solid, dashed], title='Model Tier',
                   loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(0.01, 0.87),
                   frameon=True, framealpha=0.9, fontsize=10, title_fontsize=11)
ax.add_artist(legend2)

# Width legend (inline annotation)
ax.text(0.99, 0.01, 'Line width ∝ avg score', ha='right', va='bottom',
        fontsize=9, color='#888888', style='italic')

plt.tight_layout(pad=1.5)
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor='white', edgecolor='none')
plt.close()
